basic_details.job_title: IIT Jammu Junior Research Fellow (Chemistry) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Chemistry at the Indian Institute of Technology Jammu has invited applications from Indian nationals for one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post on the ANRF-sanctioned project "Design, Synthesis, and Novel Applications of Carbene and Carbyne Precursors". The pay is 37000/- p.m. plus 20% HRA for an initial 12 months, extendable based on performance. The essential qualification is an M.Sc. or equivalent degree in Chemistry plus a qualifying national eligibility test. Applications are to be uploaded on the portal https://apply.iitjammu.ac.in/#/home by 22.11.2026 (Advt. No. IITJMU/

important_dates.interview_date: To be informed to shortlisted candidates by e-mail

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 28 years for JRF. The notice does not print an "as on" date for counting age. The upper age limit is relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST/women and physically handicapped candidates, while for OBC it is 3 years. | The notice does not name any experience requirement. For full eligibility, candidates should check the official notification.

qualification.details: Sound knowledge in the area of Organic Chemistry, especially organic synthesis, including asymmetric synthesis. Knowledge of spectroscopic methods of analysis for organic compounds.

how_to_apply: Apply through the [contract/project staff/JRF/SRF] tab on that portal, as the notice words it.
Upload the duly filled application form with the requested details, scanned copies of certificates and other supporting documents.
Upload all documents for educational qualification (10, 12, graduation, post-graduation etc.) and experience.
Give a valid e-mail ID and phone number in the application, because shortlisted candidates are informed by e-mail.
Submit the application so that it is received by 22.11.2026.

For correspondence, the notice gives: Dr. Guru Brahamam Ramani, Department of Chemistry, Indian Institute of Technology Jammu, Jagti, NH-44 Nagrota Bypass, Jammu, 182211, India. Email: [email protected].
important_instructions: The applicant is responsible for the authenticity of the information, other documents and photographs submitted. Candidates called for interview should reach IIT Jammu on their own fund. TA/DA is not permissible to appear for the offline interview or to join the position if the job is offered. Candidates who are already employed should produce a relieving certificate from their employers if selected. The application must be received by 22.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: IIT Jammu Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Design, Synthesis, and Novel Applications of Carbene and Carbyne Precursors
Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF), New Delhi
Initially for 12 Months (Extendable based on performance)
37000/- p.m. + 20% HRA for JRF (consolidated salary per month)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals may apply. The notice gives these essential conditions for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post: M.Sc. or equivalent degree in Chemistry. At least 6.5 CGPA or 60% marks in aggregate in Masters from a recognized institute/university as a full-time program. Qualified in any one of: GATE; CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and Admission to PhD; or a national-level examination conducted by Central Govt. Departments and their agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MHRD, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, etc. Sound knowledge in the area of Organic Chemistry, especially organic synthesis, including asymmetric synthesis. Knowledge of spectroscopic methods of analysis for organic compounds. The upper age limit is 28 years for JRF. The notice does not print an "as on" date for counting age. The upper age limit is relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST/women and physically handicapped candidates, while for OBC it is 3 years. The notice does not name any experience requirement. For full eligibility, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice calls this the consolidated salary per month. The post is a project position and is tied to the duration of the project work as stated above.

rows.duration: Initially for 12 Months (Extendable based on performance)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Jammu Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Open the online portal https://apply.iitjammu.ac.in/#/home . Apply through the [contract/project staff/JRF/SRF] tab on that portal, as the notice words it. Upload the duly filled application form with the requested details, scanned copies of certificates and other supporting documents. Upload all documents for educational qualification (10, 12, graduation, post-graduation etc.) and experience. Give a valid e-mail ID and phone number in the application, because shortlisted candidates are informed by e-mail. Submit the application so that it is received by 22.11.2026. For correspondence, the notice gives: Dr. Guru Brahamam Ramani, Department of Chemistry, Indian Institute of Technology Jammu, Jagti, NH-44 Nagrota Bypass, Jammu, 182211, India. Email: [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Merely possessing the prescribed qualification does not ensure that a candidate will be called for an interview. Candidates may be shortlisted based on merit and need for the project, and only shortlisted candidates will be called. Shortlisted candidates are informed about the interview by e-mail, including the date and the time. The interview will be held using the online/offline platform. Shortlisted candidates must present themselves on the interview date with an updated CV and original and attested photocopies of mark sheets/certificates supporting their academic qualifications.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the IIT Jammu JRF recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF), in the area of Chemistry, Organic Synthesis, on the ANRF-sanctioned project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Jammu JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving the duly filled-in application is 22 November 2026, through the portal https://apply.iitjammu.ac.in/#/home.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIT Jammu JRF post?
faq.answer: An M.Sc. or equivalent degree in Chemistry, with at least 6.5 CGPA or 60% marks in aggregate in a full-time Masters, and a qualifying result in GATE, CSIR-UGC NET or another listed national-level test.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIT Jammu JRF post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 28 years. It is relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST/women and physically handicapped candidates, and by 3 years for OBC.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the IIT Jammu JRF?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is 37000/- per month plus 20% HRA for the JRF.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the IIT Jammu JRF pay?
faq.answer: The notice prints the pay as 37000/- p.m. plus 20% HRA, so HRA at 20% is stated along with the consolidated salary. It prints no other allowance.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the IIT Jammu JRF post?
faq.answer: Upload the duly filled application form, scanned certificates and supporting documents on https://apply.iitjammu.ac.in/#/home through the [contract/project staff/JRF/SRF] tab by 22.11.2026.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for the IIT Jammu JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates may be shortlisted based on merit and need for the project, and shortlisted candidates are interviewed on an online/offline platform. The interview date is sent by e-mail.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the IIT Jammu JRF engagement?
faq.answer: The post is initially for 12 months and is extendable based on performance.

faq.question: Q10. Will IIT Jammu pay TA/DA for the interview or joining?
faq.answer: No. The notice says TA/DA is not permissible to appear for the offline interview or to join the position if the job is offered, and candidates should reach IIT Jammu on their own fund.
